definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating the number of years since an event, used for anniversaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧10{周年|しゅうねん}。
{会社|かいしゃ}{設立|せつりつ}50{周年|しゅうねん}。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧30{周年|しゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Next month marks their 30th wedding anniversary.

notes:
{周年|しゅうねん} is used for anniversaries.

PATTERN:
[number] + {周年|しゅうねん} = [number]th anniversary

EXAMPLES:
- 10{周年|しゅうねん}: 10th anniversary
- 25{周年|しゅうねん}: 25th anniversary
- 100{周年|しゅうねん}: 100th anniversary

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {結婚|けっこん}{周年|しゅうねん}: wedding anniversary
- {創業|そうぎょう}〜{周年|しゅうねん}: ~th anniversary of founding
